factors.name: Core on-page SEO present (title, meta description, H1, mobile viewport)
factors.note: Direct fetch of the homepage HTML confirms a title tag ('Commercial HVAC Company Dallas Fort Worth | TechBridge'), a meta description, a mobile viewport meta tag, and an H1 are all present. Docked points because the title and H1 position the business exclusively as a commercial HVAC provider for all of Dallas-Fort Worth, while the Bryant dealer page, Nextdoor listing, and third-party directory describe residential AC/furnace repair centered on Melissa, a mismatch that works against the residential local searches this audit tested.

factors.name: Structured data / schema present
factors.note: HVACBusiness and FAQPage JSON-LD schema are present on the homepage (confirmed by direct fetch and parsing of the raw HTML). Docked points because the page carries two separate HVACBusiness blocks sharing the same @id but disagreeing with each other: one is titled 'TechBridge Pacific HVAC corp' (lowercase corp) with no review data, the other is titled 'TechBridge Pacific HVAC Corp' and carries a self-reported aggregateRating of 51 reviews. A third-party directory elsewhere claims 61 reviews for the same business. Search engines and AI systems reading this schema get two different numbers from the business's own site.

factors.name: Content depth (service pages, location page, FAQ content)
factors.note: Crawl of on-site navigation found a genuinely deep page set: commercial HVAC, restaurant HVAC, rooftop unit service, commercial refrigeration, maintenance agreements, industries served, service areas, about, certifications, partners, realtors, pricing, and a blog-style guide, plus FAQ schema with real answers. Docked points for one dead service link found during this crawl (see technical_findings) and for the absence of any page built specifically around Melissa, the city this business is physically headquartered in.

factors.name: Technical health (HTTPS, no broken core links, crawlable)
factors.note: HTTPS certificate is valid and current (issued Sep 18 2026, expires Dec 17 2026). However direct checks found three concrete problems: (1) a homepage 'View Service' link to /refrigeration/ returns a 404 page; (2) robots.txt points to https://thermogridhvac.com/sitemap.xml, which itself returns a WordPress 'Page not found' page rather than a sitemap; (3) the sitemap that does work (sitemap-static.xml) lists only 3 of the roughly 15 real pages found on the site, so most of the site is not being actively submitted to search engines.

factors.name: GBP found and reasonably complete
factors.note: No Google Business Profile or Maps listing surfaced across multiple independent search passes (business name + 'Google Business Profile', business name + 'google maps', the street address, and the general query 'HVAC company Melissa TX 75454'). Absence is the finding, scored 0 per methodology; labeled Likely rather than Verified because the Google Maps UI itself was not directly loaded, only search-engine results referencing it.

factors.name: NAP consistency across listings found
factors.note: At least four independent listings exist to compare (own website, Bryant dealer page, Nextdoor page, hvacservice.io directory), so this is scored, not excluded. Address is close but not identical ('Honeysuckle Holw' on the Bryant page, Nextdoor, and the directory vs. 'Honeysuckle Hollow' spelled out in the website's own schema; city/state/zip agree everywhere). Far more serious: the business name splits across two names ('TechBridge Pacific HVAC Corp' on its own website and Nextdoor vs. 'Thermogrid HVAC Corp' on the Bryant manufacturer dealer page), and the phone number differs across three sources: (469) 609-6204 on the business's own site and schema, (213) 838-0462, a Los Angeles area code, on the Bryant dealer page, and (972) 767-9307 on its Nextdoor page.

factors.name: Appears in results for the primary local query tested
factors.note: Across 'HVAC repair Melissa TX', 'AC installation Melissa TX', and 'HVAC company Melissa TX 75454', this business surfaced only via the third-party Bryant dealer page under the name 'Thermogrid HVAC Corp', never via its own domain (thermogridhvac.com) and never via an owned Maps/GBP listing. Competitors in the same result sets (Aire Serv of McKinney, Air Patrol Air Conditioning, Premier Air & Electric) surfaced with their own branded websites and visible review counts.

factors.name: Any independently-verifiable reviews found, any platform
factors.note: No reviews were found on Google, Yelp, BBB, or Facebook under either business name across multiple search passes. The only review counts found anywhere are self-published: the business's own homepage schema claims a 5.0 rating from 51 reviews, while a third-party directory page (hvacservice.io) claims 5.0 from 61 reviews for the same business, two numbers that contradict each other, and neither could be matched to an actual visible, readable review on an independent platform. Per methodology, zero independently-verifiable reviews found anywhere scores this category 0.

factors.name: Business identity stated clearly and consistently somewhere crawlable
factors.note: Name, address, phone, and services are stated clearly on the business's own website and on its Bryant dealer page, but two different legal/trade names are in active crawlable use for the same storefront ('TechBridge Pacific HVAC Corp' vs. 'Thermogrid HVAC Corp'), which directly fails the 'consistently' bar this factor is checking for.

factors.name: Structured data / consistent NAP an AI system could read
factors.note: Schema.org structured data exists and is reasonably rich (HVACBusiness, FAQPage), but it is internally duplicated and contradictory on the business's own homepage (see website_seo structured-data factor), and does not match the name or phone number found on the Bryant manufacturer page or Nextdoor.

factors.name: Content directly answering likely customer questions
factors.note: FAQPage schema on the homepage includes real, specific answers to the questions a customer or AI assistant would actually ask: which brands are serviced, how fast emergency response is, which cities are covered, and whether multi-location maintenance agreements are available. This is the strongest, most genuinely useful content found anywhere in this audit.

factors.name: No contradictory facts across sources checked
factors.note: Multiple contradictions were directly observed across the sources checked in this audit: two business names, three phone numbers, two conflicting self-reported review counts (51 vs. 61), and a homepage that pitches commercial-only HVAC work while its dealer listing and directory profile describe residential AC/furnace repair.

technical_findings.finding: The homepage links to a refrigeration services page that returns a 404 (page not found).
technical_findings.evidence: The homepage contains a 'View Service →' card link to https://thermogridhvac.com/refrigeration/. Requesting that URL (following redirects) returns HTTP 404 and renders a WordPress 'Page not found - TechBridge Pacific HVAC Corp' page.

technical_findings.finding: robots.txt points to a sitemap URL that itself returns a 404 page instead of a sitemap.
technical_findings.evidence: robots.txt at thermogridhvac.com/robots.txt lists 'Sitemap: https://thermogridhvac.com/sitemap.xml'. Fetching that URL returns a WordPress 404 page titled 'Page not found - TechBridge Pacific HVAC Corp' rather than XML. A second sitemap listed in robots.txt, sitemap-static.xml, does return valid XML but lists only 3 URLs (pricing.html, realtors/, no-ac-survival-guide.html) out of roughly 15 real pages found by crawling the site's own navigation.
technical_findings.source: Direct curl requests to robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and sitemap-static.xml, 2026-10-07

technical_findings.finding: The homepage carries two separate, conflicting HVACBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks for the same business.
technical_findings.evidence: Both blocks share the @id 'https://thermogridhvac.com/#business'. One is named 'TechBridge Pacific HVAC corp' and includes image, email, geo coordinates, opening hours, and social links but no rating. The other is named 'TechBridge Pacific HVAC Corp' and includes an aggregateRating of 5.0 from 51 reviews and a differently formatted license identifier ('TACLA00151786R' vs. the about page's 'TACLA 00151786 R / TACLB151786').
technical_findings.source: Direct fetch and parse of homepage HTML, 2026-10-07

technical_findings.finding: The listed contact email on the business's own website is a free personal-style Gmail address, not a domain-matched business address.
technical_findings.evidence: The homepage's own JSON-LD schema lists "email":"thermogridhvac@gmail.com" despite the business owning and operating the thermogridhvac.com domain.

technical_findings.finding: HTTPS is correctly configured with a valid, current certificate.
technical_findings.evidence: TLS certificate for thermogridhvac.com is valid from 2026-09-18 to 2026-12-17; www and non-www both resolve over HTTPS with a clean redirect to the canonical non-www URL.

local_findings.finding: No Google Business Profile or Maps listing was found under either business name.
local_findings.evidence: Search passes for 'TechBridge Pacific HVAC Melissa TX Google Business Profile reviews', '"Thermogrid HVAC" Melissa TX google maps', and the street address all returned only the Bryant dealer page, Nextdoor, and directory listings, never a Maps/GBP result.

local_findings.finding: The business's own domain does not surface in generic local-intent searches; only third-party pages representing it do.
local_findings.evidence: Searches for 'HVAC repair Melissa TX', 'AC installation Melissa TX', and 'HVAC company Melissa TX 75454' surfaced the Bryant dealer page (as 'Thermogrid HVAC Corp') and competitor sites, but never thermogridhvac.com directly.

local_findings.finding: A manufacturer-certified competing business page, Aire Serv of McKinney, maintains a dedicated landing page built specifically for Melissa, despite being based in McKinney.
local_findings.evidence: aireserv.com/mckinney/geo/melissa/ is a page built specifically to target Melissa-area searchers, and it surfaced directly in the 'HVAC repair Melissa TX' search pass.

aeo_findings.finding: FAQ content on the homepage directly answers several real customer questions in a format AI assistants and Google can read.
aeo_findings.evidence: FAQPage JSON-LD on the homepage includes specific answers covering brand coverage (Carrier, Trane, Lennox, York, Goodman, Rheem, Daikin), emergency response time ('typically arrive within 2-4 hours'), service area cities, and multi-location maintenance agreements.

aeo_findings.finding: An AI system reading across this business's available sources would encounter two different business names, three different phone numbers, and two different self-reported review counts for what is otherwise the same storefront at the same address.
aeo_findings.evidence: See technical_findings and the local_google NAP-consistency factor for the specific names, numbers, and counts found.
aeo_findings.source: Cross-check of direct fetches and web search, 2026-10-07

review_findings.finding: No reviews were found on Google, Yelp, BBB, or Facebook under either 'TechBridge Pacific HVAC Corp' or 'Thermogrid HVAC Corp'.
review_findings.evidence: Search passes including 'Thermogrid HVAC Melissa TX reviews Yelp BBB', 'Thermogrid HVAC Corp BBB business profile', '"Thermogrid HVAC" Melissa yelp.com', and a site:google.com pass all returned no independent review platform result for this business.

review_findings.finding: The only two review counts found anywhere for this business contradict each other and both are self-published or unverified.
review_findings.evidence: The business's own homepage schema claims an aggregateRating of 5.0 from 51 reviews. A separate third-party directory page (hvacservice.io) claims 5.0 from 61 reviews for the same business, address, and phone number.
review_findings.source: Direct fetch of homepage JSON-LD; hvacservice.io directory page fetch, 2026-10-07

methodology_notes: No Google Search Console, GBP Insights, or live Maps-ranking API access for this business; all findings are from direct page fetches (homepage, about page, robots.txt, sitemap files, dead-link check, TLS certificate check) plus public web search, consistent with the environment limitation already documented for other records in this batch. GBP absence and review absence are based on search-engine results rather than a direct, authenticated check of the Google Maps UI, so both are labeled Likely rather than Verified. Competitor review counts (Premier Air & Electric, Air Patrol, Aire Serv of McKinney) are sourced from search-result snippets and third-party aggregators (HomeAdvisor/Angi, Google-sourced snippets), not independently cross-checked against each competitor's live Google listing in this pass, and are used only for relative comparison, not as Verified facts about this audit's own target business. The web-search tool's session budget was exhausted near the end of this audit (shared across a parallel multi-business batch); no further search passes beyond those already logged in search_observations were possible, though all planned research steps (website, GBP, reviews, competitors, NAP, AEO) had already been completed by that point. No screenshots were captured; this record is text/HTML-evidence only.
